depth_targets.title: Rotation configuration (enable/disable, on-demand, automatic schedule)
limitations: A schedule (AutomaticallyAfterDays, or a 'rate(N days)'/'rate(N hours)' ScheduleExpression) really fires on its own — Vyomi lazily checks it on the next read (GetSecretValue/DescribeSecret/ListSecrets) and rotates if the time has passed, the same on-access pattern DynamoDB TTL uses, so there is no background scheduler process but the schedule is honoured. Vyomi has no Lambda runtime wired to Secrets Manager: both automatic and on-demand rotation carry the current value forward into a fresh version — the same AWSCURRENT/AWSPREVIOUS transition a real rotation Lambda performs — without generating a new credential.

depth_targets.title: Resource permissions (resource policy)
limitations: PutResourcePolicy validates the document (valid JSON, at least one Allow/Deny statement with a Principal) and enforces the same public-policy guard real Secrets Manager applies at write time: a policy granting '*' access is rejected unless BlockPublicPolicy is set to false. What is not modeled is runtime access evaluation — Vyomi has one implicit caller identity, so the policy content never actually denies or allows a specific GetSecretValue call the way cross-account IAM evaluation would.

depth_targets.title: Encryption key (KmsKeyId)
limitations: KmsKeyId is stored and returned exactly as configured, but Vyomi does not use it to actually encrypt the secret value — SecretString/SecretBinary are never re-encrypted under the referenced KMS key.

depth_targets.title: Pick an existing RDS/DocumentDB/Redshift database instance
limitations: Only Amazon RDS is modeled: the wizard's database table lists your real RDS DB instances (DescribeDBInstances) and picking one fills in the connecting endpoint/port/engine. Vyomi has no DocumentDB or Redshift core, so those two credential types still fall back to entering connection details (user name, password, server address) by hand — the credential secret itself is stored and retrievable exactly like any other secret either way.

depth_targets.title: Cross-Region replication
limitations: Replicating a secret into other AWS Regions isn't modeled — there's no second Region's store to replicate into. The secret itself is real and single-Region.
